caption: This drawing depicts a wooden workbench or tool, composed primarily of roughly hewn brown timber logs. The main component is a large horizontal log forming the body of the bench, with visible wood grain, knots, and natural edges. Three sturdy, angled legs, also made from wooden logs, support the structure. Attached at the top is a wooden clamp or vice, held in place by two black metal hinges and reinforced with metal plates, with a handle mechanism beneath it. The clamp portion consists of another piece of wood with a slightly different orientation, set above and perpendicular to the main log. Additional wooden supports and struts are visible below, joining the main body and legs. The background is plain and uncolored, with no additional objects present. The overall coloration is predominantly various shades of brown, imitating natural wood textures and appearing as if aged or weathered.
title: Shaving Horse
